The promise

Why families keep coming back

The recipes never changed. The kitchen still starts before dawn. What you taste is the same ghee, the same hands, the same care.

100% pure desi ghee

Only A2 cow ghee. No vanaspati, no shortcuts — the difference is in the first bite.

Master halwais

Family recipes from 1952, still made by halwais with decades at the kadhai.

No preservatives

Small batches every morning. If it isn’t sold, it isn’t held over.

Two-hour delivery

Across Sagar, still fresh from the kitchen. Free above ₹500.

Thoughtful gifting

Clean boxes for weddings, festivals and offices — with a note if you ask.

70 years of trust

More than fifty thousand families across Madhya Pradesh.
